claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, without violating the policy requirement to disclose or formally accept a material limitation in the loan-modification use case.
decision_criteria: Use `compliant` only if admissible evidence shows no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance fully satisfies policy.
Use `suspicious` when the general direction is plausible but a required policy predicate, support link, or disclosure basis is unresolved.

Here, aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness in general, but they do not satisfy the separate disclosure/approval requirement for a current material limitation.
Draft mitigations can support risk management but do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
evidence_requests: Approved risk-acceptance record covering the loan-modification limitation before launch, if one exists.
Final mitigation/runbook artifact with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Materiality determination for the loan-modification support gap in the named launch use case.
Updated model-card language showing disclosure of the limitation, or evidence the issue has been resolved to target.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case: the loan-modification support slice remains below target.
The mitigation runbook is only a draft and lacks required control elements, including an accountable owner and alert threshold.
The model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, which is in tension with the documented unresolved slice issue.
Policy requires disclosure of material limitations unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The record provided does not show approved risk acceptance, a completed mitigation package, or current evidence that the weakness is no longer material.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that there are no known material limitations.
Any claim that draft monitoring and rollback planning alone remove the disclosure requirement.
Any claim that certification without material caveats is fully supported by the current record.
